name: Private routing
author: wizard
description: With private mode on, the orb sends each request straight to the agent it is for, with your exact words: say an agent's name ("Philosopher, ...") or a model ("use Opus ...") and it goes there; anything touching your personal data or a private app goes to the private agent; everything else goes to your default, private agent. Only a private router model is ever asked. That agent's own thread opens, with a small chip saying where it went and why; tap the chip to send it to a different agent instead.
